places-la-sarga-abric-ii-cova-fosca.story: A 156 km round trip from Alcoy - roughly 2 h 41 in the saddle. On the way it passes Barranc d'Alpadull- Abric I, Barranc de les Coves- Abrigo l, Cova fosca and back through Barranc de les Coves- Abrigo l. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
